description: This file defines a React Native functional component called NotesScreen, which manages a list of notes with functionalities to add, edit, delete, and display notes. It uses hooks for state management, and renders UI components such as Text, Button, Input, Modal, and ListItem to create an interactive notes interface.

methods.name: NotesScreen
methods.description: Main React component managing notes list, modal states, and rendering UI elements.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Opens the modal for creating a new note by resetting editing state.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal for editing an existing note by setting editing state and current text.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current note, either by updating an existing one or adding a new one.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a note from the list by its id.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders a single note item in the list, with tap to edit functionality.
